description: More personal data is collected or retained than is necessary for the specified processing purposes. Data collection should be limited to what is adequate, relevant, and necessary.
applicability: Applicable to data collection, storage, and retention decisions. Includes form fields, database schemas, data imports, and ongoing data retention practices.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data collection forms, database schemas, and retention policies. Assess whether each data element is necessary for the stated purpose.
